answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging a trellis of verifiable delay functions to entangle identity formation with computationally binding lotus networks, thereby rendering identity cloning infeasible. By harnessing sequential delay functions, agents' reputation commitments are embedded within a hollow tree structure, ensuring information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance, which in turn, proves the computational hardness of identity spoofing, effectively preventing Sybil attacks.
